name: toast
title: Toast
description: Sonner-style toasts with living tone icons: the outline draws itself inside a halo, a light-leak glow spills behind it, and a hairline drains along the bottom as time runs out (paused while touched). toast.promise() closes the spinning arc into the success or error circle before the mark draws in, variant="minimal" gives compact inverted pills (with a second line for the description), and variant="island" turns the Toaster into an iPhone-style Dynamic Island.
props: Global API. Also toast.success / error / warning / info / loading / promise / dismiss(id?).
Scoped store: wrap UI + <Toaster />, call useToast() instead of the global toast().
Replace the type icon, or false for none.
ms before auto-dismiss; Infinity to keep.
Reuse to update a toast in place.
Edge the stack sits on (island always sits top-centre).
Cards with a tone glow, cards filled with the solid tone, compact inverted pills, or a black Dynamic Island capsule that springs open, morphs between toasts (tap to expand, swipe up to dismiss).
Edge distance and fan-out spacing. No safe-area dependency: pass insets.top + 8 to clear a notch.
Only show toasts sent with { toaster: id }.
Success / warning / error notification haptic when a toast appears or resolves.
Style for the <Toaster> host that fills the screen and positions the stack.
